answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy requires each identity to lock a 1000 POA bond for 30 days and pass three varied tasks verified by five independent established peers. Fraud, duplicate identities, or replayed proofs burn the bond and trigger a seven-day cooldown; signed logs and rotating peer quorums make each fake identity costly. Reputation rises only after two passing rounds. A quill-signed audit records lagoon activity, delta anomalies, and haven recovery checks so coordinated agents are exposed.
